title: Antique Brass Glass Shelf, Double Tier 16-Inch X 5-Inch, Solid Brass Hardware, Gallery Rail, Waverly Place, Allied Brass
description:
Keep everyday bathroom essentials organized without crowding the vanity in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This double glass shelf adds two levels of storage, while the gallery rail keeps bottles and décor securely in place.

Highlights:
- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Built for strength and safety: 3/8-Inch thick tempered glass shelves
- Coordinate your bath hardware: part of the Waverly Place collection for a matching Waverly Place look
- Clean finished installation: concealed screw mounting hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Glass dimensions (each shelf): 16-Inch x 5-Inch
- Overall size: 16-Inch L x 5-Inch W (projection) x 8-Inch H
- Material: solid brass hardware with tempered glass shelves
- Mounting: wall mount; concealed screw mounting; assembly not required
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4-Inch
